text: いつ　ポケモンの　たいりょくが　たりなく　なるか　わかんない　もんね

structure.jp: いつ　ポケモンの　たいりょくが　たりなく　なるか
structure.en: when your Pokémon's HP will run short

structure.jp: わかんない　もんね

patterns.name: 〜か (embedded question)
patterns.span: いつ　ポケモンの　たいりょくが　たりなく　なるか
patterns.explanation: A question word plus か in the middle of a sentence wraps a question inside it, to be followed by 'don't know'. いつ ... たりなく　なるか = 'when it will run short'.

patterns.name: 〜くなる
patterns.explanation: A word ending in く followed by なる means 'come to be that way'. たりなく　なる = 'become not enough'.

patterns.name: 〜もの (reason)
patterns.explanation: もん is the casual form of もの and gives a reason, like 'because' or 'after all'. わかんない is a slurred わからない. わかんない　もん = 'because you never know'.
